caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with its lid open, revealing its interior. The wood of the chest has a light brown color with visible grain patterns. The front panel of the chest is painted in a pale turquoise color and decorated with symmetrical, swirling vine-like designs outlined in brown, with small leaf motifs included. The edges of this front panel are bordered by a scalloped design in alternating turquoise and brown. At the top center of the front panel, there is a metallic latch or lock in a silver-gray color. The side of the chest is also painted in pale turquoise, featuring a stylized flower design with elongated green petals radiating from a central turquoise oval, with brown elements between the petals. The chest sits on a plain, off-white background. The name "MAJEL G. CLAFLIN - TAOS." is written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Large Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
